source_audit_before_fitting.review: Sixteen contact-sheet examples show leaf-scale boxes, including truncated leaves. Suspected non-tomato foliage occurs among negative annotations, so negative genus supervision stays masked. Healthy labels apply only to annotated leaf ROIs; 128/141 photos containing Healthy annotations also contain non-Healthy annotations.
source_audit_before_fitting.allowed_scope: Limited binary Healthy/knownness leaf training; broad disease labels are masked for nine-class CE and knownness negatives. Never label every leaf or a mixed whole photo Healthy. No new detector training is authorized by this audit alone.
source_audit_before_fitting.limitations: Inferred timestamp/adjacent-file/perceptual families are not verified plant IDs. Clinical and species labels are publisher annotations, not independently adjudicated by this audit.
